outcome: Neonatal morbidity (requiring therapeutic hypothermia, admission to neonatal intensive care within 3 hours of birth)
cohort: Women and babies delivered between July 1, 2011, and June 30, 2017, at a large obstetric unit in England, excluding births <24 weeks gestation and planned cesarean sections
finding: While the introduction of 24/7 resident consultant presence on the labor ward did not significantly change the preexisting upward trend of increasing adverse infant outcomes overall, it was associated with a reversal of this trend in term babies (≥37 weeks gestation).
